sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Gamified, bite-sized lessons making learning fun and accessible; a vast selection of languages; expansion into diverse educational subjects (Math, Music, Chess); a proven science-based teaching methodology; and a massive, global user community.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Duolingo is a highly popular, free mobile application designed to make learning languages, and now also Math, Music, and Chess, fun and effective through bite-sized, gamified lessons. It offers practice in speaking, reading, listening, and writing, building vocabulary and grammar skills for over 40 languages.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Language learning courses (40+ languages)
Math courses
Music courses
Chess lessons and online play.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Freemium model. Basic access is free with ads and in-app purchases. A premium subscription ("Super Duolingo") offers ad-free experience, unlimited hearts, and streak repair.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Individuals of all ages globally (content rating "Everyone") interested in learning new languages, improving academic skills (math, music), enhancing cognitive abilities through chess, or for travel, school, career, and brain health.
